findings.desc: Mandatory Progress UX row is broader than the surrounding state-change contract: docs/requirements/decisions/proof-or-stop-agent-prompt-consolidation-execution-plan.md:141 and :169 scope mandatory progress UX to state-changing commands, but :172 says any human-facing command that does not auto-append progress UX must run milestone_status. Current docs/CLI.md:309-315 and packages/main/src/cli-engine.ts:843-846 scope automatic append to configured story-scoped mutating commands, so the execution-plan row should be narrowed to non-auto-appended state-changing/progress-relevant commands to avoid implementing noisy or unsafe progress requirements for unrelated read-only output.
